article_summaries.title: Free Realms - Quais são as Novidades? (item: Weekend de réduction de prix)
article_summaries.summary: This Free Realms news page (Portuguese title, French body text) announces a limited weekend discount of 30% on Station Cash marketplace items, excluding subscriptions. It gives the exact offer window in CET, so it is useful for dating a 2012 live promotion. The page gives no absolute publication date, only a relative 'Publicado 2 meses, 3 semanas atrás'.
